# obot_git_credential (Data Source)

Reads one Git credential's metadata, by ID or by a unique display name, for example to find the ID of a credential created in the Obot UI. Errors if no credential, or more than one, matches. The token is never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the ID of a credential created in the Obot UI.
data "obot_git_credential" "github" {
  display_name = "GitHub catalogs"
}

resource "obot_mcp_catalog_source" "private" {
  url               = "https://github.com/example/private-catalog"
  git_credential_id = data.obot_git_credential.github.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Display name to look up. Exactly one credential must have it.
- `id` (String) Git credential ID to look up. Set exactly one of `id` or `display_name`.

### Read-Only

- `host` (String) Git host the credential is used for.
- `token_configured` (Boolean) Whether Obot has a token stored for the credential. The token itself is never returned.
- `used_by` (Attributes List) Objects that read sources with the credential, as last recorded by Obot. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--used_by))

<a id="nestedatt--used_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `used_by`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) The object's display name.
- `id` (String) The object's ID, such as `default` for the default MCP catalog.
- `type` (String) Kind of object: `mcp_catalog`, `system_mcp_catalog`, or `skill_repository`.
